cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'm sorry I broke your graduation mug. Losing it is exactly how we learn to let go. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. That urge is why we needed this. We've confused a degree with a drinking vessel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then give me your graduation mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Losing mine will teach me generosity. We should both drink from jam jars tomorrow.

mechanism: A manages cleaning up a broken sentimental mug and yields repair help or a replacement while reframing loss as necessary growth for both.
confusable: Unlike apologizing for damage alone, A insists the damage teaches letting go; the Stance lets B demands change A method and personal cost.
comparison: A damaged sentimental gift and responsibility differ from a bakery surviving a rejected contract.
seedUse: D113-b broken graduation mug and demand for A own mug; S02-b adapts cooperation while maintaining the guiding frame.
